title: Fleuret on mushroom hunters and labradors
author: François Fleuret

metaphors.title: Mushroom Hunters and Labradors
metaphors.paraphrase: Offered as an image for the math/AI situation: mathematicians are very skilled mushroom hunters who have refined their art for centuries, and AI is a moult of extremely enthusiastic labradors that has just arrived in the forest.
metaphors.style_hint: A forest clearing with a hunter's basket and mushrooms, and a pack of dogs bounding in.
metaphors.district_reason: It casts mathematical discovery as searching a forest for mushrooms, an image of exploration and finding things in terrain.
